runs.t: Exact address shared after you RSVP

Free tickets. Food, music and culture all day. THE EXPERIENCE • 40 food vendors from across the islands • Live steel pan, soca and dancehall sets from noon • A kids zone with face painting until 4 PM • Rum cake contest at 3 PM, bring your best GOOD TO KNOW Gates open at 11 AM. Bring a chair or a blanket. No outside alcohol. Street parking fills up by noon, so ride share if you can.
